caption: Arch of Constantine, Rome
composition: Triumphal three-bay arch with Corinthian columns beside the Colosseum · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the piazza before the Arch of Constantine at early afternoon, the great three-bay arch filling the left and center of the frame. Corinthian columns, carved reliefs, and the long Latin inscription crowd its face, while the Colosseum's arcaded bulk rises at the right beyond the trees. The modelled 23 September 2026, 13:10 sky is a deep cloudless blue, and the midday sun throws crisp shadows through the archways onto the paving.
